evidence.title: A chronic shortage of troops plagues Ukraine

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian presidential appointment and Defense Ministry reform records
occurrences.quote_span: Former Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov, who was replaced by Yevhenii Khmara in the summer shake-up by Zelenskyy, had sought to reorganize the military around fewer but stronger units.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian presidential decree and Defense Ministry organizational records
occurrences.quote_span: The Defense Ministry, which in July underwent a shake-up by President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, is trying to tackle the problem with reforms to mobilization, training and the way the army is organized.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Da Vinci Wolves battalion personnel and deployment records
occurrences.quote_span: “Based on the equipment and the number of people we have today, we barely have enough to hold the sector we currently have,” said a deputy commander of the Da Vinci Wolves battalion in eastern Ukraine’s Pokrovsk area, a focus of Russia’s offensive.
occurrences.speaker: Afer
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian defense-force staffing and effectiveness assessments
occurrences.quote_span: Increasing the number of personnel in the defense forces does not necessarily increase their effectiveness, Chmut said.
occurrences.speaker: Taras Chmut
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukraine population estimates and military recruitment records
occurrences.quote_span: Convincing Ukrainians who have little incentive to fight is a major challenge after more than four years of war, and the country is struggling to recruit enough troops from its estimated population of 39 million.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Da Vinci Wolves battalion operational assessments and casualty records
occurrences.quote_span: “To move forward would inevitably mean greater losses,” said the deputy commander, who insisted on identifying himself only as “Afer” because of military rules.
occurrences.speaker: Afer
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian military unit personnel-strength records
occurrences.quote_span: Ukraine always has been outmanned by Russia, but as the war drags through its fifth year, the need for personnel is increasingly acute, commanders and analysts say, with some units at only half strength.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian military operational records for Dnipropetrovsk and Lyman
occurrences.quote_span: “We can do limited offensives,” he said, pointing to recent actions in the Dnipropetrovsk and Lyman areas, “but it’s relatively small.”
occurrences.speaker: Pavlo Narozhnyi
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: United Nations demographic figures provided by Ukraine's National Health System
occurrences.quote_span: There are about 6.8 million men aged 25-59, according to U.N. figures provided by Ukraine’s National Health System, but that includes wounded veterans and men otherwise unable to serve.
occurrences.speaker: United Nations and Ukraine National Health System
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian military specialist staffing and qualification records
occurrences.quote_span: It’s also a struggle to find qualified specialists who can operate increasingly sophisticated equipment on the battlefield, Afer said, adding that troops “who know how to think” are in short supply.
occurrences.speaker: Afer
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Battlefield control maps and front-line position records
occurrences.quote_span: But RUSI’s Reynolds said there would not be fundamental changes to the broader battlefield balance, with the front line essentially remaining the same.
occurrences.speaker: Nick Reynolds
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukraine mobilization, reserve and front-line deployment records
occurrences.quote_span: Long-standing mobilization problems, including draft dodging and desertion, make it harder for Ukraine to build its reserves, according to military experts, resulting in only incremental changes along the 1,250-kilometer (775-mile) front line.
occurrences.speaker: military experts
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian parliament defense committee records and submitted mobilization proposals
occurrences.quote_span: But the reforms will take time. Yehor Cherniev, a member of parliament’s defense committee, said lawmakers have yet to see mobilization initiatives.
occurrences.speaker: Yehor Cherniev
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian military rotation and casualty records
occurrences.quote_span: The shortage means that units can’t be rotated often enough, he said, “leading to exhaustion and, in turn, exacerbating casualties.”
occurrences.speaker: Nick Reynolds
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Russia population estimates and military recruitment records

occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Da Vinci Wolves battalion staffing and area-of-responsibility records

occurrences.speaker: Afer
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian military conscription law
occurrences.quote_span: Compulsory service applies only to men.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukraine Defense Ministry mobilization policy drafts and directives
occurrences.quote_span: Developing a new mobilization policy, including encouraging deserters to return to duty, is among the most sensitive issues under consideration, said the official, who was not authorized to brief the media and spoke on condition of anonymity.
occurrences.speaker: Ukraine Defense Ministry official
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Official Ukrainian military personnel-strength and deployment records
occurrences.quote_span: Official figures put the military’s strength at about 1 million, with only a small fraction deployed at the front.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Da Vinci Wolves battalion deployment and rotation records
occurrences.quote_span: With replacements scarce, some troops have spent up to a year at the front with little opportunity for rotation, said Afer, the deputy commander of the Da Vinci Wolves battalion.
occurrences.speaker: Afer
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukraine Defense Ministry personnel and staffing records
occurrences.quote_span: The ministry did not respond to Associated Press requests for comment, but one of its officials summarized the problem by saying, “There just are not enough people.”
occurrences.speaker: Ukraine Defense Ministry official
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukraine and Russia operational maps and military communiques
occurrences.quote_span: Ukraine can conduct localized offensives but not enough to shift the broader battlefield balance, despite mounting Russian losses.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian battlefield drone deployment and personnel-effectiveness assessments
occurrences.quote_span: Drones can sometimes alleviate the shortages.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian military registration and volunteer-service regulations
occurrences.quote_span: Women are allowed to volunteer, and those with medical or pharmaceutical training are required to register with the military.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian criminal code provisions on desertion
occurrences.quote_span: The penalty for desertion is imprisonment of up to 12 years.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Da Vinci Wolves battalion force-generation and casualty-replacement requirements
occurrences.quote_span: Ideally, at least twice as many men are needed simply to hold current positions, but that doesn’t take into account that a constant reserve of troops is needed to replace casualties, he said.
occurrences.speaker: Afer
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian unit performance, casualty and replenishment records
occurrences.quote_span: Uneven performance by front-line units worsens the problem. Weaker formations suffer heavier losses, creating a cycle of high attrition and constant replenishment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukrainian military desertion investigations and personnel surveys
occurrences.quote_span: Exhaustion, poor organization, inadequate training and the lack of a clear end-of-service date drive recruits to desert, according to soldiers and military analysts.
occurrences.speaker: soldiers and military analysts
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage

occurrences.checkable_against: Taras Chmut's statement and Ukrainian force-management records
occurrences.quote_span: Ukraine’s problem is not so much a shortage of personnel but how they are managed and deployed, said military analyst Taras Chmut, who also heads Come Back Alive, a charity providing assistance to the army.
occurrences.speaker: Taras Chmut
occurrences.subject: Ukraine's combat-ready troop shortage
